title: A mutational hotspot in AMOTL1 defines a new syndrome of orofacial clefting, cardiac anomalies, and tall stature.

reviewer.method: Personally read all374 lines of held PMC main text, including every case narrative, all3 figure legends, both tables as text, all50 references and backmatter; inspected XML table cell boundaries/headers/footnotes and component inventory; read all12 assigned packets including every alternate,170 phenotypes and12 allele descriptors.
